// GD_ASYNC_SUBMIT - Guard: inputs, idempotency key, the payload's SHAPE (every stable line error), payload_hash over the canonical text
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-async.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-async.mjs (+ scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs) - edit there.
// Create-or-return ONE gd_async_job by (tenant, organization, idempotency_key): the unique insert is the only
// write; it never prepares, never publishes, never says the delivery exists.
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const sha256Hex = function sha256Hex(text) {
  const s = String(text);
  const bytes = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    let c = s.charCodeAt(i);
    if (c >= 0xd800 && c <= 0xdbff) {
      const d = i + 1 < s.length ? s.charCodeAt(i + 1) : 0;
      if (d >= 0xdc00 && d <= 0xdfff) {
        c = 0x10000 + ((c - 0xd800) << 10) + (d - 0xdc00);
        i++;
      } else c = 0xfffd;
    } else if (c >= 0xdc00 && c <= 0xdfff) c = 0xfffd;
    if (c < 0x80) bytes.push(c);
    else if (c < 0x800) bytes.push(0xc0 | (c >> 6), 0x80 | (c & 63));
    else if (c < 0x10000) bytes.push(0xe0 | (c >> 12), 0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 63), 0x80 | (c & 63));
    else bytes.push(0xf0 | (c >> 18), 0x80 | ((c >> 12) & 63), 0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 63), 0x80 | (c & 63));
  }
  const K = [
    0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5, 0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
    0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da, 0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
    0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85, 0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
    0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3, 0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2,
  ];
  const H = [0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19];
  const bitLen = bytes.length * 8;
  bytes.push(0x80);
  while (bytes.length % 64 !== 56) bytes.push(0);
  const hi = Math.floor(bitLen / 0x100000000);
  const lo = bitLen >>> 0;
  bytes.push((hi >>> 24) & 255, (hi >>> 16) & 255, (hi >>> 8) & 255, hi & 255, (lo >>> 24) & 255, (lo >>> 16) & 255, (lo >>> 8) & 255, lo & 255);
  const rotr = (x, n) => (x >>> n) | (x << (32 - n));
  const W = new Array(64);
  for (let off = 0; off < bytes.length; off += 64) {
    for (let t = 0; t < 16; t++) W[t] = ((bytes[off + 4 * t] << 24) | (bytes[off + 4 * t + 1] << 16) | (bytes[off + 4 * t + 2] << 8) | bytes[off + 4 * t + 3]) >>> 0;
    for (let t = 16; t < 64; t++) {
      const s0 = rotr(W[t - 15], 7) ^ rotr(W[t - 15], 18) ^ (W[t - 15] >>> 3);
      const s1 = rotr(W[t - 2], 17) ^ rotr(W[t - 2], 19) ^ (W[t - 2] >>> 10);
      W[t] = (W[t - 16] + s0 + W[t - 7] + s1) >>> 0;
    }
    let a = H[0], b = H[1], c = H[2], d = H[3], e = H[4], f = H[5], g = H[6], h = H[7];
    for (let t = 0; t < 64; t++) {
      const S1 = rotr(e, 6) ^ rotr(e, 11) ^ rotr(e, 25);
      const ch = (e & f) ^ (~e & g);
      const t1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[t] + W[t]) >>> 0;
      const S0 = rotr(a, 2) ^ rotr(a, 13) ^ rotr(a, 22);
      const mj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
      const t2 = (S0 + mj) >>> 0;
      h = g;
      g = f;
      f = e;
      e = (d + t1) >>> 0;
      d = c;
      c = b;
      b = a;
      a = (t1 + t2) >>> 0;
    }
    H[0] = (H[0] + a) >>> 0;
    H[1] = (H[1] + b) >>> 0;
    H[2] = (H[2] + c) >>> 0;
    H[3] = (H[3] + d) >>> 0;
    H[4] = (H[4] + e) >>> 0;
    H[5] = (H[5] + f) >>> 0;
    H[6] = (H[6] + g) >>> 0;
    H[7] = (H[7] + h) >>> 0;
  }
  return H.map((x) => x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")).join("");
};
const GDC = {"codes":{"CMD_UNKNOWN_COMMAND":{"message":"Unknown command"},"PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID":{"message":"Payload hash is not 64-char lowercase SHA-256 hex"},"JOB_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION":{"message":"Illegal job state transition"},"JOB_ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT":{"message":"Job changed concurrently; re-read it before acting"},"GD_VALIDATION_FAILED":{"message":"Validation failed"},"GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING":{"message":"Required field missing"},"GD_INVALID_DATA":{"message":"Invalid data"},"GD_INVALID_ITEM":{"message":"Material not found or has been deleted"},"GD_INVALID_UOM":{"message":"Invalid unit of measure"},"GD_INVALID_QUANTITY":{"message":"Invalid quantity"},"GD_SO_CLOSED":{"message":"Sales order is closed"},"GD_ALLOCATION_FAILED":{"message":"Allocation failed"},"GD_INSUFFICIENT_STOCK":{"message":"Insufficient stock"},"GD_STOCK_CHANGED":{"message":"Stock changed; review highlighted lines"},"GD_CONFIRM_ZERO_QUANTITY":{"message":"Lines with zero delivery quantity"},"GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED":{"message":"Temporary failures persisted; not saved"},"GD_INVENTORY_REJECTED":{"message":"Inventory rejected the delivery before any stock change"},"GD_INVENTORY_RETRYABLE_REJECTION":{"message":"Stock is busy; retrying"},"GD_INVENTORY_IN_PROGRESS":{"message":"Inventory operation still running; waiting"},"GD_INVENTORY_REQUIRES_REVIEW":{"message":"Stock outcome under review (ref {review_reference})"},"GD_PUBLISH_AFTER_INVENTORY_FAILED":{"message":"Stock moved but the delivery could not be published; under review"},"GD_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED":{"message":"Material or stock shape not supported by the V2 inventory path yet"},"GD_TOO_MANY_EFFECTS":{"message":"This delivery is too large for one save; please split it into smaller deliveries"},"IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID":{"message":"Idempotency key missing or malformed"},"IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED":{"message":"Idempotency key already used for a different request"},"GD_TRANSIENT_CONNECTIVITY":{"message":"Temporary connectivity failure; retrying"},"GD_RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH":{"message":"Save outcome requires review"}},"max_effects":20000};
const gdPayloadShape = function gdPayloadShape(text, maxAllocations, maxEffects) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const ID = /^[0-9]{1,19}$/;
  const DATE = /^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01]) ([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$/;
  const errors = [];
  const err = (lineNo, key, field, code, message) => errors.push({ line_no: lineNo, stable_line_key: key, field: field, code: code, message: message });
  let p = null;
  try {
    p = typeof text === "string" ? JSON.parse(text) : text;
  } catch (e) {
    p = null;
  }
  if (!p || typeof p !== "object" || Array.isArray(p)) {
    err(null, "", "request_payload", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "request_payload is not a JSON object");
    return { ok: false, header: null, lines: [], errors: errors, ids: null };
  }
  if (s(p.command) !== "CREATE_GD_FROM_FORM") err(null, "", "command", "CMD_UNKNOWN_COMMAND", "command must be CREATE_GD_FROM_FORM");
  const h = p.header && typeof p.header === "object" && !Array.isArray(p.header) ? p.header : null;
  if (!h) err(null, "", "header", "GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING", "header missing");
  const lines = Array.isArray(p.lines) ? p.lines : null;
  if (!lines || !lines.length) err(null, "", "lines", "GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING", "lines missing or empty");
  if (h) {
    const dn = s(h.delivery_no);
    if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9\/._:-]{1,64}$/.test(dn)) err(null, "", "delivery_no", "GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING", "delivery_no: 1-64 of A-Z a-z 0-9 / . _ : - (it is compared as SQL text)");
    // OI4 (2026-10-02): "issued" = the number is assigned by the organization's numbering rule when the hidden header
    // is inserted (the frozen save's own placeholder); it needs the rule id in delivery_no_type
    else if (dn === "issued" && !/^[0-9]{1,19}$/.test(s(h.delivery_no_type))) err(null, "", "delivery_no_type", "GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING", "delivery_no 'issued' (numbered on insert) needs delivery_no_type = the numbering rule id");
    if (!ID.test(s(h.plant_id))) err(null, "", "plant_id", "GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING", "plant_id: digits");
    if (!ID.test(s(h.customer_name))) err(null, "", "customer_name", "GD_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING", "customer_name: the customer id (digits)");
    if (!DATE.test(s(h.delivery_date))) err(null, "", "delivery_date", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "delivery_date: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss");
    if (h.so_id !== undefined && h.so_id !== null && h.so_id !== "" && !(Array.isArray(h.so_id) && h.so_id.every((x) => ID.test(s(x))))) err(null, "", "so_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "so_id: an array of sales order ids");
  }
  const seen = {};
  const outLines = [];
  const ids = { materials: {}, locations: {}, uoms: {}, sos: {}, soLines: {}, tuples: {}, autoMaterials: {}, autoUoms: {} };
  // Item bundles (user decision B-1, 2026-10-03): a bundle is ONE row with the bundle's items under `children`, the
  // shape the old save stores (gd_workflow.enabled.dev.v237.json code_node_IyJHrBst isBundleParentRow: item_bundle_id
  // set and no material). The tree is flattened here, in tree order (the bundle row, its items, the next row): the
  // flat position is the line_no (unique: effect keys <line_no>.<seq>.<TYPE>.OUT stay unique), the same flat walk the
  // old save's prepareAllocationData (code_node_kJx9p9Nh) numbers rows by. The bundle row is kind BUNDLE (no material,
  // no allocation, no effect); its items are kind ITEM with parent_key = the bundle row's key. Default keys: "L<i>" by
  // top-level position, "<bundle key>.<j>" for an item.
  const flat = [];
  (lines || []).forEach((raw, i) => {
    const l = raw && typeof raw === "object" && !Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : {};
    const kids = Array.isArray(l.children) ? l.children : [];
    const isBundle = kids.length > 0 || (s(l.item_bundle_id) !== "" && s(l.material_id) === "");
    const key = s(l.stable_line_key) || "L" + (i + 1);
    flat.push({ raw: l, kind: isBundle ? "BUNDLE" : "ITEM", key: key, parent: null, top: i + 1, child: 0 });
    if (!isBundle) return;
    const parent = flat[flat.length - 1];
    kids.forEach((rawKid, j) => {
      const c = rawKid && typeof rawKid === "object" && !Array.isArray(rawKid) ? rawKid : {};
      flat.push({ raw: c, kind: "ITEM", key: s(c.stable_line_key) || key + "." + (j + 1), parent: parent, top: i + 1, child: j + 1 });
    });
  });
  const anyBundle = flat.some((f) => f.kind === "BUNDLE");
  flat.forEach((f, n) => {
    const lineNo = n + 1;
    const l = f.raw;
    const key = f.key;
    const bundle = f.kind === "BUNDLE";
    if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,48}$/.test(key)) err(lineNo, key, "stable_line_key", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "stable_line_key: 1-48 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -");
    if (seen[key]) err(lineNo, key, "stable_line_key", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "duplicate stable_line_key");
    seen[key] = true;
    const materialId = s(l.material_id);
    const bundleId = s(l.item_bundle_id);
    const uomId = s(l.gd_order_uom_id);
    const qty = s(l.gd_qty) === "" ? "0" : s(l.gd_qty);
    if (bundle) {
      if (materialId !== "") err(lineNo, key, "material_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "an item bundle row carries no material_id (its items are its children)");
      if (!ID.test(bundleId)) err(lineNo, key, "item_bundle_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "item_bundle_id: digits");
      if (!(Array.isArray(l.children) && l.children.length)) err(lineNo, key, "children", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "an item bundle row needs its items under children");
      if (!/^[0-9]{1,15}(\.[0-9]{1,8})?$/.test(qty) || !/[1-9]/.test(qty)) err(lineNo, key, "gd_qty", "GD_INVALID_QUANTITY", "an item bundle row needs gd_qty > 0 (the number of bundles), a decimal with at most 8 fractional digits");
      const bAllocs = l.temp_qty_data;
      if (!(bAllocs === undefined || bAllocs === null || bAllocs === "" || bAllocs === "[]" || (Array.isArray(bAllocs) && !bAllocs.length))) err(lineNo, key, "temp_qty_data", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "an item bundle row carries no allocations: nothing is delivered against the bundle row itself");
      if (!s(l.so_line_item_id) && (l.children || []).some((c) => c && typeof c === "object" && s(c.so_line_item_id))) err(lineNo, key, "so_line_item_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "the bundle's items name sales order lines: the bundle row needs its own sales order line (so_line_item_id)");
    } else {
      if (!ID.test(materialId)) err(lineNo, key, "material_id", "GD_INVALID_ITEM", "material_id: digits");
      if (!ID.test(uomId)) err(lineNo, key, "gd_order_uom_id", "GD_INVALID_UOM", "gd_order_uom_id: digits");
      if (!/^[0-9]{1,15}(\.[0-9]{1,8})?$/.test(qty)) err(lineNo, key, "gd_qty", "GD_INVALID_QUANTITY", "gd_qty: a decimal >= 0 with at most 8 fractional digits");
    }
    if (f.parent) {
      if (Array.isArray(l.children) && l.children.length) err(lineNo, key, "children", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "an item of a bundle carries no children of its own (one bundle level only)");
      // review fix round 1, M-6: an item carries its bundle's id (the Picking's bundle row is built from it: an item without
      // one would be picked as a loose row)
      if (!bundleId) err(lineNo, key, "item_bundle_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "an item of a bundle needs its bundle's item_bundle_id (" + s(f.parent.raw.item_bundle_id) + ")");
      else if (bundleId !== s(f.parent.raw.item_bundle_id)) err(lineNo, key, "item_bundle_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "item_bundle_id differs from its bundle row's (" + s(f.parent.raw.item_bundle_id) + ")");
    }
    const soId = s(l.line_so_id);
    const soLineId = s(l.so_line_item_id);
    if (soId && !ID.test(soId)) err(lineNo, key, "line_so_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "line_so_id: digits");
    if (soLineId && !ID.test(soLineId)) err(lineNo, key, "so_line_item_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "so_line_item_id: digits");
    if (soLineId && !soId) err(lineNo, key, "line_so_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "so_line_item_id needs line_so_id");
    let allocs = l.temp_qty_data;
    if (typeof allocs === "string" && allocs.trim()) {
      try {
        allocs = JSON.parse(allocs);
      } catch (e) {
        allocs = null;
        err(lineNo, key, "temp_qty_data", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "temp_qty_data is not JSON");
      }
    }
    if (allocs === undefined || allocs === null || allocs === "") allocs = [];
    if (!Array.isArray(allocs)) {
      err(lineNo, key, "temp_qty_data", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "temp_qty_data must be an array of allocations");
      allocs = [];
    }
    const outAllocs = [];
    let sum = 0n;
    const units = (v) => {
      const m = String(v).match(/^([0-9]+)(?:\.([0-9]{1,8}))?$/);
      return m ? BigInt(m[1]) * 100000000n + BigInt(((m[2] || "") + "00000000").slice(0, 8)) : null;
    };
    allocs.forEach((a, j) => {
      const seq = j + 1;
      const x = a && typeof a === "object" ? a : {};
      const loc = s(x.location_id);
      const q = s(x.gd_quantity);
      if (!ID.test(loc)) err(lineNo, key, "temp_qty_data[" + seq + "].location_id", "GD_INVALID_DATA", "allocation " + seq + ": location_id: digits");
      const u = units(q);
      if (u === null || u <= 0n) err(lineNo, key, "temp_qty_data[" + seq + "].gd_quantity", "GD_INVALID_QUANTITY", "allocation " + seq + ": gd_quantity: a positive decimal with at most 8 fractional digits");
      else sum += u;
      const batch = s(x.batch_id);
      const hu = s(x.handling_unit_id) || s(x.hu_id);
      outAllocs.push({ allocation_sequence: seq, location_id: loc, quantity: q, batch_id: batch, hu_id: hu });
      if (ID.test(loc)) ids.locations[loc] = true;
      if (ID.test(loc) && ID.test(materialId)) ids.tuples[materialId + "," + loc] = true;
    });
    const qu = units(qty);
    if (qu !== null && outAllocs.length && sum !== qu) err(lineNo, key, "temp_qty_data", "GD_INVALID_QUANTITY", "allocations sum " + String(sum) + " units do not equal gd_qty");
    if (ID.test(materialId) && !bundle) ids.materials[materialId] = true;
    if (ID.test(uomId) && !bundle) ids.uoms[uomId] = true;
    if (ID.test(soId)) ids.sos[soId] = true;
    if (ID.test(soLineId)) ids.soLines[soLineId] = true;
    // a line with a quantity and no Select Stock may be auto-allocated (prepareAutoAllocate reads these)
    if (!bundle && !outAllocs.length && qu !== null && qu > 0n && ID.test(materialId)) {
      ids.autoMaterials[materialId] = true;
      if (ID.test(uomId)) ids.autoUoms[uomId] = true;
    }
    // a bundle row's raw without its `children`: the items are lines of their own here, and every reader of raw ignores
    // the key (fix round 2: the subtree was carried twice in Parse's output, F48)
    let rawOut = l;
    if (bundle && Array.isArray(l.children)) {
      rawOut = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(l)) if (k !== "children") rawOut[k] = l[k];
    }
    const o = { line_no: lineNo, stable_line_key: key, material_id: materialId, uom_id: uomId, quantity: qty, so_id: soId, so_line_id: soLineId, so_no: s(l.line_so_no), unit_price: s(l.unit_price), allocations: bundle ? [] : outAllocs, raw: rawOut };
    // the bundle keys only when the payload has a bundle (a plain delivery's lines stay as they were: kind ITEM, no
    // parent, line_index = line_no - every reader defaults to that; the line text is inlined in the Finish script, I3)
    if (anyBundle) {
      o.kind = f.kind;
      o.parent_key = f.parent ? f.parent.key : "";
      o.item_bundle_id = bundleId;
      o.line_index = f.child ? f.top + "/" + f.child : String(f.top);
    }
    outLines.push(o);
  });
  // no line maximum (2026-10-02): the one bound is the allocations one save can carry - a line without Select Stock
  // counts one (the auto allocation gives it at least one; prepare counts the real effects after it); an item bundle
  // row counts none (it carries no stock; its items count as lines)
  const totalAllocations = outLines.reduce((n, l) => n + (l.kind === "BUNDLE" ? 0 : Math.max(1, l.allocations.length)), 0);
  const thousands = (x) => String(x).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
  if (maxAllocations !== undefined && totalAllocations > maxAllocations) err(null, "", "lines", "GD_TOO_MANY_EFFECTS", "This delivery is too large for one save: it has " + thousands(totalAllocations) + " stock allocations (a line without Select Stock counts as one) and one save can carry at most " + thousands(maxAllocations) + " stock allocations (" + thousands(maxEffects !== undefined ? maxEffects : maxAllocations * 3) + " inventory effects). Please split it into smaller deliveries.");
  const list = (o, dummy) => {
    const k = Object.keys(o).sort();
    return k.length ? k : [dummy];
  };
  const idsOut = {
    materialIdsSql: list(ids.materials, "0").join(","),
    locationIdsSql: list(ids.locations, "0").join(","),
    uomIdsSql: list(ids.uoms, "0").join(","),
    soIdsSql: list(ids.sos, "0").join(","),
    soLineIdsSql: list(ids.soLines, "0").join(","),
    tuplesSql: list(ids.tuples, "0,0").map((t) => "(" + t + ")").join(","),
    autoMaterialIdsSql: list(ids.autoMaterials, "0").join(","),
    autoUomIdsSql: list(ids.autoUoms, "0").join(","),
  };
  return { ok: errors.length === 0, header: h, lines: outLines, errors: errors, ids: idsOut };
};
const submitGuard = function submitGuard(input) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const inp = input || {};
  const tenantId = s(inp.systemTenantId);
  const organizationId = s(inp.organizationId);
  const plantId = s(inp.plantId);
  const key = s(inp.idempotencyKey);
  const nonce = (s(inp.uuid).replace(/[^0-9a-fA-F]/g, "").toLowerCase() + "000000000000000000000000").slice(0, 24);
  const base = { route: "REJECT", tenantId: "0", organizationId: "0", plantId: "0", idempotencyKey: "NONE", nonce: nonce, payloadText: "", payloadHash: "", confirmationHash: "", correlationId: "", lineCount: 0, sourceSoIds: "[]", sourceSoNo: "", errors: [], result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: "" };
  const bad = (code, why, errors) => Object.assign({}, base, { result_code: code, result_message: why, errors: errors || [{ line_no: null, stable_line_key: "", field: "", code: code, message: why }] });
  if (!/^[0-9]{1,20}$/.test(tenantId)) return bad("GD_INVALID_DATA", "no session tenant");
  if (!/^[0-9]{1,19}$/.test(organizationId)) return bad("GD_INVALID_DATA", "organization_id: digits");
  if (!/^[0-9]{1,19}$/.test(plantId)) return bad("GD_INVALID_DATA", "plant_id: digits");
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9:_-]{16,128}$/.test(key)) return bad("IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID", GDC.codes.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID.message + ": 16-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 : _ -");
  const confirmationHash = s(inp.confirmationHash);
  if (confirmationHash && !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(confirmationHash)) return bad("GD_INVALID_DATA", "confirmation_hash: 64 lowercase hex characters, or empty");
  const correlationId = s(inp.correlationId) || key;
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9|:._-]{1,128}$/.test(correlationId)) return bad("GD_INVALID_DATA", "correlation_id: 1-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 | : . _ -");
  let payload = inp.payload;
  if (typeof payload === "string") {
    try {
      payload = JSON.parse(payload);
    } catch (e) {
      return bad("GD_INVALID_DATA", "payload is not JSON");
    }
  }
  const shape = gdPayloadShape(payload, Math.floor(GDC.max_effects / 3), GDC.max_effects);
  // a delivery above the one size bound: the message itself, addressed to the user (the form shows result_message;
  // there is no line to point at, so no line errors - the form would repeat the text as "Header: ...")
  const tooLarge = shape.errors.filter((e) => e.code === "GD_TOO_MANY_EFFECTS")[0];
  if (tooLarge) return bad("GD_TOO_MANY_EFFECTS", tooLarge.message, []);
  if (!shape.ok) return bad(shape.errors[0].code, GDC.codes.GD_VALIDATION_FAILED.message + ": " + shape.errors[0].message, shape.errors.slice(0, 500));
  if (s(shape.header.plant_id) !== plantId) return bad("GD_INVALID_DATA", "header plant_id " + s(shape.header.plant_id) + " differs from plant_id " + plantId);
  if (s(shape.header.organization_id) && s(shape.header.organization_id) !== organizationId) return bad("GD_INVALID_DATA", "header organization_id " + s(shape.header.organization_id) + " differs from organization_id " + organizationId);
  const text = canonicalJson(payload);
  const hash = sha256Hex(text);
  const echo = s(inp.payloadHash);
  if (echo && echo !== hash) return bad("PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID", GDC.codes.PAYLOAD_HASH_INVALID.message + " (or it does not match the payload)");
  const soIds = {};
  for (const l of shape.lines) if (l.so_id) soIds[l.so_id] = true;
  const soNo = shape.lines.map((l) => l.so_no).filter((x) => x)[0] || s(shape.header.so_no);
  return Object.assign({}, base, { route: "CONTINUE", tenantId: tenantId, organizationId: organizationId, plantId: plantId, idempotencyKey: key, payloadText: text, payloadHash: hash, confirmationHash: confirmationHash, correlationId: correlationId, lineCount: shape.lines.length, sourceSoIds: canonicalJson(Object.keys(soIds).sort()), sourceSoNo: soNo });
};
const res = submitGuard({ organizationId: [{{workflowparams:organization_id}}][0], plantId: [{{workflowparams:plant_id}}][0], idempotencyKey: [{{workflowparams:idempotency_key}}][0], payload: [{{workflowparams:payload}}][0], confirmationHash: [{{workflowparams:confirmation_hash}}][0], correlationId: [{{workflowparams:correlation_id}}][0], payloadHash: [{{workflowparams:payload_hash}}][0], systemTenantId: [{{system:tenantId}}][0], uuid: [{{system:uuid}}][0] });
console.log("submit guard", JSON.stringify({ route: res.route, key: res.idempotencyKey, hash: res.payloadHash, lines: res.lineCount, result: res.result_code, errors: res.errors.length }));
return res;

const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle

const submitDecide = function submitDecide(guard, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r);
  const dbNow = list.length ? s(list[0].db_now) : "";
  const job = list.filter((r) => s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const base = { route: "REJECT", dbNow: dbNow, jobId: job ? s(job.id) : "", jobStatus: job ? s(job.job_status) : "", jobAddRows: [], needAdd: "NO", jobUpdRows: [], needUpd: "NO", created: "NO", result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: job ? s(job.job_status) : "" };
  if (!job) {
    const row = { organization_id: guard.organizationId, plant_id: guard.plantId, command: "CREATE_GD_FROM_FORM", idempotency_key: guard.idempotencyKey, payload_hash: guard.payloadHash, confirmation_token: "", confirmation_hash: guard.confirmationHash, correlation_id: guard.correlationId, causation_id: "", source_so_ids: guard.sourceSoIds, source_so_no: guard.sourceSoNo, line_count: guard.lineCount, job_status: "QUEUED", progress_percent: 0, progress_message: GDC.display.QUEUED, attempt_count: 0, cancel_requested: 0, row_version: 0, request_payload: guard.payloadText, gd_id: "", gd_no: "", queued_at: dbNow };
    return Object.assign(base, { route: "CREATE", jobAddRows: [row], needAdd: "YES", created: "YES", result_message: "job created (QUEUED)", job_status: "QUEUED" });
  }
  if (String(job.is_deleted) !== "0") return Object.assign(base, { result_code: "IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED", result_message: GDC.codes.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.message + ": the key is occupied by soft-deleted job " + s(job.id) + " (a deleted row keeps its unique key)" });
  if (s(job.payload_hash) !== guard.payloadHash) return Object.assign(base, { result_code: "IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED", result_message: GDC.codes.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.message + ": job " + s(job.id) + " carries payload_hash " + s(job.payload_hash) });
  const status = s(job.job_status);
  if (guard.confirmationHash && guard.confirmationHash !== s(job.confirmation_hash) && (status === "AWAITING_CONFIRMATION" || status === "QUEUED")) {
    return Object.assign(base, { route: "CONFIRM", jobUpdRows: [{ id: s(job.id), confirmation_hash: guard.confirmationHash, next_attempt_at: dbNow, row_version: (Number(job.row_version) || 0) + 1 }], needUpd: "YES", result_message: "confirmation_hash stored on job " + s(job.id) + " (" + status + "): the worker prepares it again" });
  }
  return Object.assign(base, { route: "RETURN", result_message: "job " + s(job.id) + " already exists (" + status + ")" });

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.idempotency_key,
       j.job_status,
       j.payload_hash,
       j.confirmation_hash,
       j.progress_message,
       j.row_version,
       CAST(j.gd_id AS CHAR) AS gd_id,
       j.gd_no,
       j.is_deleted
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_EluyWNR5.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_EluyWNR5.data.organizationId}}'
   AND j.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_EluyWNR5.data.idempotencyKey}}'
